title: A finitely generated field extension becomes separable after finite purely inseparable extensions
statement: Let $K/k$ be a finitely generated field extension [def-pc-field-extension] (i.e. $K=k(a_1,\dots,a_n)$ for finitely many $a_1,\dots,a_n\in K$). Then there exist a field $K'$ with a field homomorphism $K\to K'$, and a subfield $k'\subseteq K'$ containing the image of $k$ under $k\to K\to K'$, such that $k'/k$ is a finite purely inseparable extension and $K'/K$ is a finite purely inseparable extension [def-weil-pbc-finite-purely-inseparable-extension], and $K'/k'$ is a separable field extension in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-separable-field-extension]. In other words there is a commutative square of field extensions $k\to k'\to K'$, $k\to K\to K'$ with $k'/k$, $K'/K$ finite purely inseparable and $K'/k'$ separable.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 030R (lemma-make-separable, line 10513), first assertion, and its proof (Lemma Tag 04KM lemma-make-separably-generated, Lemma Tag 030X lemma-separably-generated-separable); the further assertions $K'=k'K$, $K'=(k'\otimes_kK)_{red}$ of 030R are not part of this node

proof.text: Let $K/k$ be finitely generated, $K=k(a_1,\dots,a_n)$. By [lem-weil-pbc-make-separably-generated] there are a field $K'$ with a field homomorphism $K\to K'$ and a subfield $k'\subseteq K'$ containing the image of $k$ under $k\to K\to K'$, such that $k'/k$ and $K'/K$ are finite purely inseparable [def-weil-pbc-finite-purely-inseparable-extension] and $K'$ is separably generated over $k'$ [def-weil-pbc-separable-field-extension] (1). Since $k$ maps into $k'$ by the composite $k\to K\to K'$, the square $k\to k'\subseteq K'$, $k\to K\to K'$ commutes.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 030R (lemma-make-separable, line 10513), proof, first two sentences

proof.text: The extension $K'/k'$ is separably generated, hence separable over $k'$ in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-separable-field-extension] (2) by [lem-weil-pbc-separably-generated-separable]. Thus $k'$, $K'$ of step 1 satisfy all requirements: $k'/k$, $K'/K$ finite purely inseparable and $K'/k'$ separable.
